title: Very fun project and ultimately quite surreal. Built my entire home town using Claude and Unity. Took around 1 1/2 days.  Used satellite imagery, Lidar maps from USGS, and street view.
author: No_Departure7494
selftext:
I think we all kind of desire familiarity and for the longest time I wanted to see what my hometown would look like in any type of game. How long it would take to race from one end to the other without having to abide by any traffics laws. Flying over in a helicopter. Having a shootout or defending against an alien invasion in not so alien territory.

Using Claude $20 a month plan.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
I've been making a Sydney map for similar reasons. Familiarity is a rich vein to tap into :)

I went for "taxi cab" vibes so it's a bit more chill. It's quite cool already tho zooming around familiar territory. 

https://preview.redd.it/pdmgydhil6uh1.png?width=1253&format=png&auto=webp&s=6d486c5b641a2199cef9b15a3e4ea82f9af93eac

replies.author: No_Departure7494
replies.body:
I am torn. I posted it on my instagram page and then deleted it because no one that LIVED THERE even seemed impressed hahaha. So I figured - If they don't care, why would a random person?

Sure, I'd release it! 

To be clear - The 7/11 and Gas station really had some TLC put in, the rest are place holders. If you were from this little suburb, maybe there'd be a greater sense of amazement because, again - it's familiar. You know it.
